purpose: The control plane (GATE-TRAIN-SERVICES, D-086, ADR-41): the Cloudflare Worker forge-webhook in services/control-plane, a Node service apart from the Python runner that owns the operational state once deployed (/status, /healthz, /readyz, /metrics, /events, the runner and admin calls), its node --test suite, and its deploy through the Cloudflare REST API (D-291 (6)).
